name: io.github.maxkuminov/obsidian-mcp
title: Obsidian MCP Server
description: Self-hosted agent memory as a markdown vault: semantic and keyword search, wikilink graph, OAuth

host.description: Hostname of your own deployment (MCP_HOSTNAME). There is no public instance: you host this server yourself.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <API key> minted in the control panel (omcp_...). Omit it to connect via OAuth instead.

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector (0.8.0+) connection URL for the app's NON-superuser role, e.g. postgresql+asyncpg://obsidian_mcp:<password>@postgres:5432/obsidian_mcp. A superuser role or a CHANGE_ME password is refused at startup.

environmentVariables.name: VAULT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path of the Obsidian vault inside the container (mount your vault read-write there).

environmentVariables.name: SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: itsdangerous signer for cookies/sessions. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`; the app refuses to start on a placeholder.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HOSTNAME
environmentVariables.description: Public hostname your reverse proxy routes to. Also derives BASE_URL, ALLOWED_ORIGINS and ALLOWED_HOSTS as https://<MCP_HOSTNAME> unless those are set explicitly.

environmentVariables.name: EMBEDDING_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Embedding provider: `ollama` (self-hosted, default) or `openai` (bring your own key). Switching after deploy requires `make reset-embeddings`.

environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Ollama endpoint serving bge-m3 (used when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=ollama). Must be https or loopback unless EMBEDDING_ALLOW_PLAINTEXT is set.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI (or OpenAI-compatible) API key for text-embedding-3-* (required when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=openai; the server refuses to start without it).
